verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ou valaauina i lona lava igoa, o Pesaleli le atalii o Auri, o le atalii lea o Huro, o le itu aiga o luta.

verses.en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.sm: Ua ou faatumuina foi o ia i le Adapa o le Atua, i le poto, ma le faautauta, ma lc iloa lelei e fai ai galuega uma lava;

verses.en: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.sm: ina ia mafaufau o ia i galuega faigata; ina ia galue o ia i le auro, ma le ario, atoa ma le ‘apa memea;

verses.en: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.sm: e togitogi foi i maa, e faamau ai, e togitogi foi i laau, e fai ai galuega uma lava.

verses.en: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua ou tuuina atu ia te ia, o Aliavu le atalii o Aisamako, o le itu aiga o Tanu; ua ou tuu foi le poto i loto o e popoto uma lava, ina ia latou faia o mea atoa uma ua ou fai atu ai ia te oc;

verses.en: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
verses.sm: o le fale fetafai o le. faapotopotoga, ma le atolaau o le tulafono, ma le nofoa o le alofa ei ona luga, ma mea uma o le fale fetafai;

verses.en: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
verses.sm: o le laoai ma ana mea uma, o le tuugálamepa auro lelei ma ana mea uma, ma le fata e mu ai mea manogi;

verses.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
verses.sm: o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu ma ana mea uma lava, o le taelega ma lona tulaga;

verses.en: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
verses.sm: ma ie o mea e fai aʻi tapuaiga, ma ofu sa O le ositaulaga o Arona, o ofu foi o ona atalii e fai ai le faiva o ositawada;

verses.en: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
verses.sm: o le uu foi e faauu a“, ma le mea manogi lelei e mu mo le mea paia; faapei o mea uma ua ou fai atu ai ia te oe, ia latou faia lava.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
verses.sm: la e fai atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea. atu i ai, Tou te tausi lava i oʻu sapati, auà o le faailoga lea ia te au ma outou, e oo i a outou tupulaga amuli, ina ia iloa ai, o aʻu nei o le ALII, o le faapaiaina outou.

verses.en: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.sm: la outou tausi i le sapati, aua e paia lava ia ia te outou; o le na te solia, ia fasiotia lava o ia; ana ai se tasi e fai ai se galuega, ia vavaeeseina lea i lona nuu.

verses.en: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.sm: E ono aso e fai ai galuega, a o le aso fitu o le sapati lea e malolo ai, e paia i le ALII; ai se tasi e fai ai sana galuega i le aso sapati e fasiotia lava o ia.

verses.en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
verses.sm: la tausi e le fanauga a Isaraelu i le sapati, e fai ma sapati i a outou tupulaga amuli, o le feagaiga e faavavau.

verses.en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
verses.sm: O le faailoga lea e faavavau ia te au atoa ma le fanauga a Isaraelu; auā o aso e ono na fai ai e le ALII le lagi atoa ma le lalolagi; a o le aso fitu na ia malolo ai, ma mapu ai.

verses.en: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.sm: Ua uma atu ana fetalaiga ia Mose i le mauga o Sinai, ona avatu ai lea e ia ia te ia o papa e lua o le tulafono, o papa maa lava na tusia e le aao o le Atua. Ua fai e
